description: What the workflow-command-runner returns for a registered assignment (one carrying the WORKFORCE_RELAY_BINDING_V1 and WORKFORCE_RELAY_REQUEST_V1 lines). The runner returns the small object the registered helper printed; the plugin's PreToolUse hook supplies the exact saved output. When the runner's Bash call fails, it returns the unknown result: state unknown, exitCode 0, stdout empty, receipt null, bridge false, error empty, so the hook reports the real saved state. The workflow script (the relay shared block, scripts/shared-blocks/relay.js) accepts a completed result only when its receipt matches the request, the command checksum, the exit status, the byte count and the SHA-256 of stdout.

state.description: completed: the command ran and its saved output is handed back. not-started: the request provably never ran; the workflow, not the runner, decides whether it is attempted again. unknown: the runner could not tell (its Bash call failed); every other field then holds its empty value (exitCode 0, stdout empty, receipt null, bridge false, error empty).

exitCode.description: The exit status of the registered command.

stdout.description: The command's saved stdout, verbatim. Never interpret, reconstruct or copy the payload by hand.

receipt.description: The integrity receipt of the saved output, or null when there is none.

bridge.description: true only on the result the hook itself supplies; the runner's own result always carries false, and the workflow reads any other value as the runner's copy.

error.description: Why the outcome is not completed, or empty.

Receipt.description: Binds a saved output to the request that produced it.

request.description: The request id the workflow script computed for this command.

commandSha256.description: The SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the command's argument list.

exitCode.description: The exit status the saved output records.
